response.goal: We get partnership requests by email. We want each new email in our Partners Gmail label summarized by an AI model and added to Airtable: sender, company, request type, a 2-sentence summary and a priority flag. A person on our team reviews anything marked low confidence.

plan.step: Configure Gmail API connection and label monitoring
Integrate AI summarization and extraction logic
Set up Airtable base schema and write records
Testing, handling low confidence reviews, and deployment

milestones.name: Milestone 1
milestones.deliverable: Gmail and Airtable integration script with AI extraction logic

milestones.name: Milestone 2
milestones.deliverable: End-to-end testing, confidence flag handling, and final deployment

proof_map.step: Configure Gmail API connection and label monitoring

risks.risk: The job post requests OpenAI API while the project proof uses Gemini API.
risks.mitigation: Adapt the AI extraction and summarization code to use OpenAI API as specified.

risks.risk: Budget is specified as an hourly rate range rather than a fixed project price.
risks.mitigation: Track hours diligently and provide weekly progress reports.

questions: What specific fields are currently configured in your Airtable base for partnership requests?
What criteria determine whether a request is flagged as low confidence?
assumptions: The client will provide necessary API keys and access credentials for Gmail and Airtable.
Python will be used as the programming language for this automation.
